findings.current: The one I had encountered three years ago was something that could never have emerged from an E-Rank Gate, much less should have.
findings.defect: “Much less should have” creates a malformed logical relationship between impossibility and prohibition instead of preserving both parallel negations.
findings.rationale: The source states separately that the creature could not emerge from an E-Rank Gate and must not be allowed to emerge from one.
findings.replacement: The creature I had encountered three years ago was something that could not—and should not—have emerged from an E-Rank Gate.
findings.source: 3년 전 내가 맞닥트린 그놈은 E급 게이트에서 나올 수도, 나와서도 안 되는 존재였다.

findings.current: One of the higher monsters classified as dragonkin, along with drakes.
findings.defect: “Higher monsters” is an unnatural and imprecise rendering of a monster’s tier.
findings.rationale: 상위 몬스터 denotes an upper-tier or high-tier monster, not a physically or comparatively “higher” monster.
findings.replacement: One of the high-tier monsters classified as dragonkin, along with drakes.
findings.source: 드레이크와 함께 이른바 용족(龍族)으로 분류되는 상위 몬스터 중 하나다.

findings.defect: “Team Leader One” misidentifies an ordinal team title as though “One” were a name.
findings.rationale: 1팀장 refers to the leader of Team One; the source does not introduce a person named or titled “Team Leader One.”
findings.replacement: “That bastard, the leader of Team One.”

findings.current: Steam poured from Im Kkeokjeong’s mouth as he wore his thick, one-piece armor.
findings.defect: The draft invents visible steam in a hot jungle and renders the exertion idiom 단내가 나다 literally incorrectly; “as he wore” also makes wearing the armor sound like a simultaneous action.
findings.rationale: 단내가 뿜어져 나왔다 conveys severe exertion and labored breathing, while 통짜 갑옷 describes heavy solid armor rather than generic “one-piece armor.”
findings.replacement: Im Kkeokjeong, clad in thick, solid plate armor, panted raggedly.
findings.source: 두꺼운 통짜 갑옷을 걸친 임꺽정의 입에서 단내가 뿜어져 나왔다.

findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around an Item, contrary to the required System-panel formatting.
findings.rationale: The source brackets identify the Item, but the binding Markdown rules require System notices to omit such square brackets.

findings.current: Along with a cry that raised goose bumps, a massive shadow enveloped the more than twenty people.
findings.defect: “More than twenty” changes the approximate quantity 이십여 명 into a strict lower bound.
findings.rationale: 이십여 명 means approximately twenty or twenty-odd people, unlike the earlier explicit 이십 명이 넘는, which does mean more than twenty.
findings.replacement: Along with a cry that raised goose bumps, a massive shadow enveloped the roughly twenty people.
findings.source: 모골이 송연해지는 울음소리와 함께 거대한 그늘이 이십여 명의 사람들을 감싸 안는다.

summary: Six actionable findings: one quantity error, two meaningful fidelity issues, and three localized terminology/Markdown problems.
